title: Power Pack #33 Marvel 1987 Spider-Man Cameo Warlock Sunspot New Mutants
conditionDescription: Bright, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Power Pack #33 (November 1987), Marvel Comics. Guest-starring Warlock and Sunspot of the New Mutants, plus a black-costume Spider-Man cameo - and Franklin Richards is back. Bogdanove/Barta cover. $1.00 cover price.

Back cover: Meatloaf "Heroes Helping Heroes" Special Olympics ad with the Marvel heroes.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
